name: Slogan Trademark Checker — Etsy & Print-on-Demand Ban Shield

parameters.content:
## Slogan Trademark Checker — Etsy & Print-on-Demand Ban Shield

Check your print-on-demand phrases against live US trademarks before you list them.

Paste your t-shirt, mug and sticker slogans into a Google Sheet, one per row. This workflow checks each phrase against live USPTO trademark records with Magnova's USPTO Trademark Search Actor on Apify, and writes the result back into your sheet:

- **RISK — live trademark match**: an identical live trademark exists in a print-on-demand class (clothing 025, housewares 021, paper goods 016, textiles 024). The owner's name and the trademark serial number are written back with the verdict.
- **CHECK — similar live mark**: a live mark in those classes contains your phrase. Worth a closer look before you list.
- **No live match found**: no exact or phrase-containing live mark in those classes.

### How it works

1. On a daily schedule (or whenever you run it manually), the workflow reads every slogan in your sheet that does not have a verdict yet.
2. Each slogan is checked one at a time against the USPTO Trademark Search Actor, limited to LIVE marks only.
3. A Code node compares the returned marks with your slogan: an exact match in a print-on-demand class is RISK, a phrase-containing mark is CHECK, anything else is "No live match found".
4. The verdict, owner and serial number are written back into the same row of your sheet.

### What it costs

The Actor charges $0.004 per trademark record returned, capped at 10 records per slogan — at most 4 cents a slogan, usually less — charged on your own Apify account.

### What you need

- A free Apify account and API token (the free tier is enough to start)
- A Google account, and a sheet with the headers **Slogan | Verdict | Owner | Serial** in a tab named **Slogans**, one slogan per row

### Important

This is a screening aid, not legal advice. Similar-sounding marks, other classes and unregistered trademarks can still cause takedowns. For a slogan that matters, have a trademark attorney review it.

By Magnova — pay-per-event Actors on clean public data. No logins, no CAPTCHA bypass.

## Read unchecked slogans

Reads the rows of your Slogans sheet that do not have a verdict yet, then hands them to the loop one at a time.

## Check each slogan

Runs the USPTO Trademark Search Actor for the slogan (live marks only) and decides the verdict: RISK, CHECK, or No live match found.

## Write the verdict back

Writes the verdict, owner and serial number into the same row the slogan came from, then the loop moves to the next slogan.
